tasks.title: Document only actual shared operations and policies
tasks.goal: Update the user/developer journeys from implemented CLI/API behavior and accepted prototype policy.
steps: Read actual completed operations/schema examples from the accepted capability register; verify command spelling against implemented help/registration before documenting it.
Document source/choice/change/debugger/adapter/derivative workflows, explicit preparation/effects, errors/recovery and algorithmic migration.
State own 1.0.0 prototype, owner-only graduation, current A/B-ready-disabled policy and default smoke/explicit skip; distinguish available initial scope from future HOME/Docker/full ETO closure.
positive_cases: Each documented journey has a real source/API example and evidence pointer.
CLI and machine examples describe the same semantics and authority.
negative_cases: No proposed/unimplemented command is advertised as shipped.
Publication or version number cannot imply stability, full tests or live B activation.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-cli target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-cli <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-mcp target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-mcp <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
acceptance: Documentation can be followed against the actual implemented interfaces.
Public claims match current accepted scope and explicit unavailable/partial states.
tasks.safe_stop: Accurate local documentation is ready without any public release claim.
tasks.commit_subject: docs: document implemented prototype operations and recovery
notes: All source law references are permanent canonical specs; do not make campaign task files the only home of product behavior.

tasks.title: Validate documentation examples and machine contracts
tasks.goal: Exercise documented examples through headless surfaces and retain a reproducible capability matrix.
steps: Execute documented pure examples and isolated admitted action examples using exact prepared fixtures, not real user/project state.
Compare CLI/API/MCP results, model links and error examples; replace stale command examples only after implementation evidence.
Publish a local capability compatibility matrix identifying initial-route completion, M-15 pending status, M-17-D pending status and optional tracker scope.
positive_cases: A documented operation reproduces its structured response and expected effect.
Failure examples identify exact typed reason and safe next action.
negative_cases: No prose-only or shell-scraped response can count as universal machine coverage.
Missing full-test or smoke execution stays visibly missing/skipped.
